caption: The drawing features a botanical composition centered on three ripe peaches shaded in hues of orange, yellow, and red, each attached to branches with elongated green leaves. Surrounding the peaches, twisting brownish stems carry clusters of small, round berries in shades of red and pale yellow. Scattered throughout the image are additional green leaves, each with serrated edges, attached to the winding branches. The background is a solid, muted pale grayish-beige color, with the various botanical elements distributed evenly across the surface. The illustration is framed by a wide off-white or cream-colored border. The artist's name, "Hazen," is handwritten in light pencil in the lower left corner of the border.
title: Wall Paper
